summary.title: TechYaks
summary.one_liner: TechYaks is a ranked index of over 80K software development tech talks, listing each talk's event, speaker, length and view and like counts.
takeaways: TechYaks ranks over 80K software development talks algorithmically to surface notable presentations.
Each listing shows the event, speaker, duration, view count and, for many, like count.
The page features talks from events such as PyCon, CppCon, Clojure Conj, GOTO, and Strange Loop, among others.
Notable speakers on the list include Rich Hickey, Alan Kay, Bret Victor, Rob Pike and Joe Armstrong.
summary.summary: The TechYaks home page describes itself as a collection of over 80,000 software development tech talks, ranked algorithmically to surface the industry's best presentations from past, present and future. The page text is a list of about 50 featured talks, each with its title, event and year, speaker, running time, view count and, for many, like count. Topics range from language design and programming history to API design, game development, distributed systems and retro computing. The page does not explain the ranking algorithm in detail.
